<function name="GetAlignment" parent="DNotify" type="panelfunc">
	<description>Returns the current alignment of this notification panel. Set by <page>DNotify:SetAlignment</page>.</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number{ContentAlignment}">The direction of the content, based on the number pad. See <page>Enums/ContentAlignment</page>.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
